observation.command:
cd /workspace && cat > /tmp/zammad_env.sh <<'EOF'
export RAILS_ENV=development
export REDIS_URL=redis://127.0.0.1:6379
export MEMCACHE_SERVERS=
export VITE_RUBY_HOST=127.0.0.1
export ZAMMAD_BIND_IP=0.0.0.0
export ZAMMAD_RAILS_PORT=3000
export ZAMMAD_WEBSOCKET_PORT=6042
export PATH="/usr/local/bin:$PATH"
EOF
source /tmp/zammad_env.sh
nohup foreman start -f Procfile.dev > /tmp/zammad_foreman.log 2>&1 &
echo "started pid $!"
sleep 45
echo "=====LOG====="
tail -60 /tmp/zammad_foreman.log
